name: Nari
description: A Hyozan Reckoner with needle-tipped metal gloves and an expertise in poisons.

timeline.summary: Five Hyozan Reckoners led by Nari arrive with Satoru's channeler, revealing they were watching Kaito and that the job was a setup to find Tameshi.
timeline.quote: He hoped you'd lead us to Tameshi."
